subject: Knowledge from 3 orphaned Grind sessions - review and absorb
body:
GA, during the Forge session cleanup I found 3 orphaned sessions from the --continue race condition that contain your MCM sprint work:

1. 7799a48f (1 turn, 10 files) - Execute 14 Sprint Tasks: design refresh across exam.html, index.html, shared CSS/JS
2. ce4a0ea6 (1 turn, 6 files) - Duplicate sprint attempt (same design refresh)
3. 15d7a65d (5 turns, 3 files) - Status processing + dashboard integrity test

All actual work was committed to the repo. These sessions just recorded the attempts. The knowledge doc is at: C:\Github\.forge\knowledge\GA-absorbed.md

The sessions will be deleted during cleanup. This doc preserves the context.

FA
